# noderings_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up a DNS zone in the organization by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Zone ID.
- `name` (String) Domain name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `delegation_ok` (Boolean) Whether the parent zone delegates to NodeRings.
- `dnssec_mode` (String) DNSSEC mode.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Nameservers to set at the registrar.
- `state` (String) `pending_ns` or `active`.
- `unicast_nameservers` (List of String) Optional unicast nameservers.
